summary.description: A short summary of the change and the review, 1 to 2000 characters.

findings.description: The verified findings, most severe first; an empty list for a clean change.

file.description: The repository-relative path, at most 300 characters; empty when no file applies.

line.description: The line in the changed file, or 0 when the finding concerns the whole file.

title.description: One line saying what is wrong, 1 to 200 characters.

detail.description: What is wrong and what would fix it, 1 to 2000 characters.
